title: Hold a pad for its menu
thisBuild: Hold any pad for its menu, like a right click: Piano, Doctor it, Hear it, Swap sound, Star, Clear pad.
Piano drops a keyboard right under that pad's row and lights the bottom of the pad. One per row, so four pads, a piano, four pads, a piano, and every pad stays put.
Every page has a scroll bar on the right: drag the pink handle, or tap the track to jump.
View size in the ☰ menu: zoom out to 70% to fit more of the machine on the screen.
watch: Put a melodic sound in each row, hold one pad per row and open its piano.
Try 80% view size and see if the pads are still easy to hit.
limits: Creature cards, the Ring, jams and duels stay on the site.
It stops playing a while after you leave the app.
